_what: Facts that must never be wrong. The build checks each one against the live pages and stops if a page changed. Dates and times come from the participant page's lab cards and the Timeline page.

verbatim.label: Never goes in
verbatim.text: Clients, donors, volunteers and anyone you serve never go into Claude or your AI-Labs folder, and neither do health or case details. Staff names in your everyday writing are fine. Passwords, account numbers and personnel matters stay out too, and your organization's own policy comes first.

verbatim.label: Spreadsheets (Lab 4)
verbatim.text: People's names never go into Claude, and organization names reach it only as placeholders like ORG-01.

verbatim.label: Your Claude account
verbatim.text: If your organization already gives you a Claude seat, use that. Otherwise, each of you uses your own individual Claude Pro account. You set it up, it belongs to you, and it stays yours after the program. Wells Fargo covers your Claude Pro account for six months. Rachel Bruce from RW Institute emails you about how the payment reaches you. Choose the monthly plan, not the annual one.

verbatim.label: After six months
verbatim.text: When the six months end, your Claude subscription keeps charging your card each month until you cancel it.

verbatim.label: Who can see your chats
verbatim.text: Nobody at RW Institute or PCI can see your chats or files.

verbatim.label: Recording
verbatim.text: Everything in the main room is recorded.

verbatim.label: Zoom link
verbatim.text: Your sessions and the Zoom link come from the RSVP link in the welcome email.

verbatim.label: Attendance
verbatim.text: Plan to be there live for at least five of the seven.

verbatim.label: Stuck
verbatim.text: Email Nichole Giller at nichole@realizedworth.com, say which step you're on, and add a screenshot if you can.
